verdict.rationale: The pipeline retrieved readable guidance text from multiple public esd.wa.gov pages, including the homepage, employer requirements, unemployment taxes and quarterly reports, with a keyless standard UA. The probe record describes these guidance pages as open, with the login wall confined to the secure.esd.wa.gov transactional host, which is not the public reading surface. Missing for 10: no explicit probe confirming the absence of a CAPTCHA, bot wall or JS-only shell on esd.wa.gov (openness is inferred from successful text extraction), no recorded robots.txt policy for esd.wa.gov, and no independent corroboration of agent access.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service's published guidance pages are reachable by a keyless agent with a standard identified user agent — no bot wall, JS-only shell, or CAPTCHA in front of the public reading surface
